items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I'd heard of him from New Orleans... another cat, Bob Row, he was a hell of a piano player.

ctx.x: Yes. Oh, I'd heard of him from New Orleans because that's all you could hear. You see the crowd where I hung out, you see I lived way up town. I used to, Steve Lewis used to bring me down to '25.' That was a place where piano players in the afternoon would hang out. And all of them were sharp and pimp style, you know.

And I'd go down there, and oh, I, all I could hear was Tony Jackson and Louis Wade and (Clark) Wade was his brother, who was a big time pimp. And another cat, Bob Row, he was a hell of a piano player.
